pages.title: Making Furrows
pages.text: Turn at least one soil block into farmland with a working Plow.

pages.title: Making Furrows
pages.text: Mechanization changes how the work is done.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Craft the Plow using JEI, then attach and lower it using its native controls. Actual tilling earns completion.

pages.title: Till with a plow
pages.text: Hitch the Plow to yourself or a tamed horse or donkey, then sneak-interact to lower it for real tilling.

pages.title: Move farm cargo
pages.text: Pull the cart yourself or hitch it to a tamed horse or donkey. Sneak-interaction opens its cargo or unhitches it; it transports real inventory.

pages.title: Work traits help a pickaxe on appropriate stone, a shovel on vali
pages.text: Work traits help a pickaxe on appropriate stone, a shovel on valid soil and an axe on logs. A correct tool and supported block are required, rather than any hit on a surface.
